# Regulations
The Unique Identification Authority of India periodically issues regulations and amendments to strengthen the Aadhaar ecosystem. These updates ensure secure authentication, efficient enrolment and update processes, data protection, and streamlined governance, adapting to evolving technological and administrative requirements.
Updated Regulations 
Access updated UIDAI regulations on enrolment, authentication, data security, fees, information sharing and employee service rules
Updated Regulations![Updated Regulations](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowLeftBlue.svg)
Gazetted Notifications
Access gazetted notifications and amendment regulations related to Aadhaar enrolment, authentication, data sharing, fees and UIDAI operations.
